key.name: linux-accelerator
key.description: One of F8, F9, F10, F11, or F12. The host application keeps this value in sync with hotkey.linux_accelerator.

key.name: auto-paste
key.description: When enabled, the Shell extension sends Ctrl+V after the host puts text on the Wayland clipboard.

key.name: mode
key.description: One of walkie_talkie, realtime_long, or meeting.
